scope.source_publication_rule: Separate incident, original publication, subsequent update, collection and horizon clocks; exact pre-cutoff knowledge is not inferred from date-only publication or retrospectively updated article bodies.

new_events.actor: Unknown attacker; vessel master reporting via UKMTO
new_events.summary: UKMTO Warning 188-26 reportedly records vessel struck on port side by unknown projectile at 1800 UTC, 40 nautical miles south of Lavan Island, Iran, causing fire. Crew reportedly safe; no reported environmental impact. Hull/IMO, projectile type, attacker and final damage status unknown. Distinct from Oct29 Louise 1 limpet devices northeast of Khasab; not linked to Iran's unverified four-tanker tally.

geospatial.source_location_description: 40 nautical miles south of Lavan Island, Iran, Arabian Gulf
geospatial.uncertainty_note: Offset is a descriptive radius/bearing, not an authenticated latitude/longitude; warning's original PDF/coordinates remain to be retrieved.

new_events.summary: Coalition announced drone interceptions over Saudi Eastern Region and subsequently toward Southern Region, attributing Southern-bound drone to Houthis. Reuters copy calls Eastern event 'early Saturday' despite Oct30 19:37 UTC page timestamp; do not assign unverified occurrence to either side of ET cutoff. Friday Medina drone claim and Houthi denial are prior separate drawer. No exact flight track, impact, launch site, independent BDA or casualties established.

geospatial.source_location_description: Saudi Eastern Region and Southern Region; two broad regions, no individual impact coordinates
geospatial.uncertainty_note: Not plot-ready; regions are not coordinates and timing may cross the evidence cutoff.

new_events.actor: United States Embassy Riyadh / State Department
new_events.summary: US Embassy said ordered departure of non-emergency government employees and families effective October 23, publicly reported Oct30 14:32 EDT; special authorization for government staff using Saudi airports. Retrospective effective date is NOT a new Oct30 departure or evidence every affected person departed. Warning references Houthi attacks and aviation disruption.

geospatial.source_location_description: Saudi Arabia countrywide diplomatic security policy
geospatial.uncertainty_note: No sourced strike-grade coordinates; do not place a precise marker.

new_events.actor: Pakistan armed forces spokesman Lt Gen Ahmed Sharif Chaudhry
new_events.summary: In Reuters interview Pakistan military spokesman described Iran-US mediation as 'cautiously optimistic', said Mecca defence pact text does not bar additional members including potentially Iran subject to political decisions, reaffirmed Pakistan's Saudi defense commitment but denied Pakistan is a party to Yemen conflict. Additional troop deployment depends on future political decisions; no Iran membership, ratification change, troop movement or combat action established.

geospatial.source_location_description: Rawalpindi interview and regional diplomatic policy
geospatial.uncertainty_note: No sourced strike-grade coordinates; do not place a precise marker.

existing_event_updates.summary: IRGC Navy said four tankers had caught fire/exploded in unauthorized routes, with claimed fourth supertanker >2m barrels. Reuters could not verify claims or link UKMTO projectile reports to claimed vessels. Preserve as changed actor tally, not four independently verified attacks; publication timestamp is before window start and subsequent update time unknown.

geospatial.source_location_description: Strait of Hormuz, alleged southern unauthorized routes
geospatial.uncertainty_note: Actor claim has no vessel identities or strike points.

existing_event_updates.summary: IMO live highlighted confirmed-incident registry now displays 122 confirmed incidents as at Oct30 and 24 seafarer fatalities, versus earlier Oct19 114 incident snapshot. Count is cumulative and cannot be summed with UKMTO or private provider weekly counts; displayed incident table's latest listed hull is Oct23, so the registry does not itself confirm today's UKMTO reports.

existing_event_updates.summary: Reuters early Friday reports Qatar shuttle visit and incompatible U.S. nuclear-first versus Iranian sanctions/blockade-first sequencing. No later in-window signed settlement, IAEA implementation, sanctions lift or Hormuz reopening established. Trump said war would wrap up soon but provided no timetable or signed instrument.

existing_event_updates.summary: AP reports Lebanese military court charges against 13 people tied to previously seized truck carrying 780kg explosives on Beirut-Bekaa highway: two detained, 11 charged in absentia. Hezbollah acknowledged ownership and claims material was intended for Israeli targets; accusations of intended domestic assassination not established. Court charges are not convictions and are not a new explosives seizure.

Folha article at 19:35 Brazil local instead reports January Brent $113.10 and WTI $102.95, monthly +14.32%/+13.86%; source discrepancy preserved for exchange-contract/observation-time reconciliation, not silently averaged. coverage.method: Targeted English-language public OSINT: Reuters/AP wire, Guardian/FT, regional press, UKMTO warning secondary digest, IMO primary cumulative registry, OFAC official sanctions listing, WFP/IAEA prior statements, EIA and energy-market Reuters coverage. No paid AIS/Kpler/LSEG terminals or authenticated private maritime feeds. Source time exactness explicitly limited.

Commercial shipping / AIS / Kpler / LSEG public

limitations: UKMTO original Warning 188-26 PDF not independently downloaded; 1800 UTC incident and 40NM south of Lavan corroborated via Reuters and secondary numbered-warning digest.
Reuters 19:37 UTC Friday article says Saudi Eastern interception occurred 'early Saturday'; source day conflict prohibits confident in-window occurrence assignment.
AP Lebanese court report and IMO as-of Oct30 registry lack verified exact publication clock; inclusion is source-discovery/continuity not proof of new post-noon occurrence.
Reuters oil article page displays initial 02:27 UTC timestamp despite later settlement content; later update clock unresolved and alternative Folha settlement differs.
No licensed paid AIS, Kpler or LSEG feed. Do not infer vessel IDs, origin, geolocation, BDA, actor attribution, military command or intent.
Previous Oct30 noon sweep is merged into main but unconsumed relative to latest accepted canonical cutoff at start of collection; no duplication of its new events.
